title: Local Bounti Receives Continued Listing Standard Notice from NYSE

body_markdown:
HAMILTON, Mont.


, Nov. 25, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Local Bounti Corporation (NYSE: LOCL) ("Local Bounti" or the "Company"), a breakthrough U.S. indoor agriculture company, today announced that on November 19, 2026, it received a notice (the "Price Criteria Notice") from the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE") that it is not in compliance with the NYSE continued listing standards set forth in Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual (the "Price Criteria") because the average closing price of the Company's common stock, par value $0.0001 per share (the "Common Stock"), was less than $1.00 over a consecutive 30 trading-day period.


In accordance with NYSE procedures, the Company plans to timely notify the NYSE that it intends to cure the average closing stock price deficiency and to return to compliance with the NYSE's continued listing standards. The Company is required to regain compliance by six months following the receipt of the Price Criteria Notice (the "Price Criteria Cure Period"). If, at the expiration of the Price Criteria Cure Period, both a $1.00 closing share price and a $1.00 average closing share price over the preceding 30 trading days are not attained, the NYSE will commence suspension and delisting procedures. Alternatively, the Company can demonstrate an accelerated cure based on a $1.00 share price on both the last trading day of any calendar month within the Price Criteria Cure Period and the average share price over the 30 trading days preceding the end of that month.


The Company intends to consider all available alternatives to cure the stock price non-compliance including, but not limited to, a reverse stock split. Under the NYSE's rules, if the Company determines that it will cure the stock price deficiency by taking an action that will require stockholder approval, it must so inform the NYSE in its notification, obtain stockholder approval by no later than its next annual meeting of stockholders and implement the action promptly thereafter. The Price Criteria deficiency will be deemed cured if the price promptly exceeds $1.00 per share, and the price remains above that level for at least the following 30 trading days.


The Notice has no immediate impact on the listing of the Common Stock, which will continue to be listed and trade on the NYSE during the Price Criteria Cure Period, subject to the Company's ongoing compliance with the NYSE's other continued listing standards, other than the Minimum Market Capitalization Standard, for which the Company remains subject to the Plan and the Minimum Market Capitalization Cure Period, each as defined and described below.


As previously disclosed, the Company is also not in compliance with the continued listing standards set forth in Section 802.01B of the NYSE Listed Company Manual (the "Minimum Market Capitalization Standard"). In addition, the Company remains subject to its accepted plan submitted to the NYSE (the "Plan") for curing the Minimum Market Capitalization Standard deficiency, which deficiency was extended to August 5, 2027 by a written notice from the NYSE on November 4, 2026. The cure periods under the Minimum Market Capitalization Standard and the Price Criteria operate independently of each other, and the NYSE could take delisting action under one standard while the Company remains within the cure period for the other.


The Company is considering all available options to regain compliance with the NYSE continued listing standards. The Company can provide no assurances that it will be able to satisfy any of the steps outlined above, or in previous press releases the Company has issued, and maintain the listing of its shares on the NYSE.


**About Local Bounti**


Local Bounti is redefining indoor farming with an innovative method – its patented Stack & Flow Technology® – that significantly improves crop turns, increases output and improves unit economics. Local Bounti operates advanced indoor growing facilities across the United States, servicing approximately 13,000 retail doors. Local Bounti grows healthy food utilizing a hybrid approach that integrates the best attributes of controlled environment agriculture with natural elements. Local Bounti's sustainable growing methods are better for the planet, using 90% less land and 90% less water than conventional farming methods. With a mission to 'revolutionize agriculture, ensuring accessibility to fresh, sustainable, locally grown produce and nourishing communities everywhere for generations to come,' Local Bounti's food is fresher, more nutritious, and lasts longer than traditional agriculture. To find out more, visit localbounti.com or follow Local Bounti on LinkedIn for the latest news and developments.
